neighbours.label: Looking back at a past time from later on: 'back then', 'at that time', 'at the time'
fire: There weren't many cars around back then in our town.
As far as anyone knew at that time, the bridge was safe.
It was the fastest computer on the market at the time.
Nobody thought much of it back then.
She was only ten at that time and lived abroad.
It had the biggest screen on sale at the time.
Few people owned a phone back then.
The law was still new at that time.
quiet: There aren't many cars around here in our town.
As far as anyone knows today, the bridge is safe.
It is the fastest computer on the market today.
Nobody thinks much of it now.
She is only ten this year and lives abroad.
It has the biggest screen on sale this week.
Few people own a phone here.
The law is still new this year.

predictions: Retrospective phrases fire; present-time phrases stay quiet.
